sceneGoals: Turn a certainty into a doubt
Answer one question and open another
sceneQuestions: Who has the most to lose here?
What truth can no longer remain hidden?
Which promise is about to break?
What price would make success feel like failure?
Who is watching from the margins?
Why can the obvious solution not work?
Which detail from earlier becomes important now?
focus: Give the quietest protagonist the decisive clue.
Ask what the threat is doing off-screen.
Cut to the person carrying the greatest secret.
Return to an object introduced earlier.
Let an ally demand an answer now.
Show the cost through an innocent bystander.
Put two incompatible desires in the same room.
Reveal how the location itself is changing.
